notes.title: 🚛Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths Demo 🧰 Patch #2
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Mechanics,
[/b]
We have pushed a new update including some needed fixes for the camera movement and some tutorial improvements. 


[h1][b]FIX[/b][/h1]

- small gameplay fixes
- we have improved the graphics of the environment
- we have tweaked the UI
- we have improved optimizations
- we have removed flying textures
- mechanic camera was rework (it's easier to navigate now)
- tutorial update (More steps have been added to make it easier to learn the functionality)
- typo corrections
